CREATE TABLE users(id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)); CREATE TABLE categories(id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE); CREATE TABLE products(id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,category_id INT NOT NULL,sku VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,price_cents BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(price_cents>=0),stock INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(stock>=0),FOREIGN KEY(category_id) REFERENCES categories(id)); CREATE INDEX products_category_id ON products(category_id); CREATE INDEX products_name_lower ON products(name); CREATE TABLE orders(id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,user_id BIGINT NOT NULL,status ENUM('pending','paid','shipped','cancelled') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',total_cents BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,created_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),updated_at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE); CREATE INDEX orders_user_id ON orders(user_id); CREATE INDEX orders_status ON orders(status); CREATE TABLE order_items(id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,order_id BIGINT NOT NULL,product_id BIGINT NOT NULL,quantity INT NOT NULL CHECK(quantity>0),unit_price_cents BIGINT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(order_id) REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,FOREIGN KEY(product_id) REFERENCES products(id)); CREATE INDEX order_items_order_id ON order_items(order_id); CREATE INDEX order_items_product_id ON order_items(product_id); CREATE TABLE audit_log(id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,order_id BIGINT NOT NULL,old_status VARCHAR(20),new_status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,at TIMESTAMP(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)); CREATE INDEX audit_log_order_id ON audit_log(order_id); CREATE TRIGGER order_items_total_insert AFTER INSERT ON order_items FOR EACH ROW UPDATE orders SET total_cents=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity*unit_price_cents),0) FROM order_items WHERE order_id=NEW.order_id),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=NEW.order_id; CREATE TRIGGER order_items_total_update AFTER UPDATE ON order_items FOR EACH ROW UPDATE orders SET total_cents=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity*unit_price_cents),0) FROM order_items WHERE order_id=NEW.order_id),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=NEW.order_id; CREATE TRIGGER order_items_total_delete AFTER DELETE ON order_items FOR EACH ROW UPDATE orders SET total_cents=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity*unit_price_cents),0) FROM order_items WHERE order_id=OLD.order_id),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id=OLD.order_id; CREATE TRIGGER orders_audit_insert AFTER INSERT ON orders FOR EACH ROW INSERT INTO audit_log(order_id,old_status,new_status) VALUES(NEW.id,NULL,NEW.status); CREATE TRIGGER orders_audit_update AFTER UPDATE ON orders FOR EACH ROW INSERT INTO audit_log(order_id,old_status,new_status) SELECT NEW.id,OLD.status,NEW.status WHERE NOT(NEW.status <=> OLD.status); CREATE VIEW user_order_totals AS SELECT u.id AS user_id,u.name,count(o.id) AS orders,COALESCE(sum(o.total_cents),0) AS total_cents FROM users u LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id=u.id AND o.status<>'cancelled' GROUP BY u.id,u.name;
